summary: Iteration 6 (real global satellite imagery + AIS live) tested end-to-end. Backend: 19/19 pytest passed against public URL. Covers (1) GET /api/satellite/collections → collections includes sentinel-1-grd + sentinel-2-l2a, basemaps list (3 GIBS layers) and gibs_template starting with https://gibs-. (2) POST /api/satellite/search validations — bad collection 400, inverted/out-of-range bbox 400, area >3600 deg² 400 all working. Real STAC search over Strait of Malacca [98,-1,105,6] 2026-05-15..2026-06-07 returned ≥1 S1 scene with stac_id/datetime/platform/footprint/registered_scene_id fields. S2 max_cloud=30 returned scenes with cloud_cover<30. (3) GET /api/satellite/preview unknown collection 400; real S1 scene preview proxied returned image/* content-type with >1000 bytes. (4) POST /api/satellite/register with detect:false returned 201 with scene.provider=sentinel-1, storage_ref=https://planetarycomputer STAC href, metadata.preview_href set; scene visible in GET /api/scenes; re-register returned already_registered:true; detect:true returned case + spill_observation + detector_note containing 'mock'/'placeholder'. (5) GET /api/ais/live/status any role → configured:false, enabled:false, connected:false, running:true, bboxes[] present. PUT /api/ais/live/settings analyst → 403; admin bad bbox shape 400; >10 bboxes 400; admin PUT {api_key:'x', bboxes:[[[10,-5],[20,5]]], enabled:true} persisted (enabled=true, configured=true), backend remained healthy after 15s sleep, then restored via api_key:'', enabled:false. Regression /api/cases and /api/zone-rules still 200. Frontend (Playwright, public URL): Analyst login → nav-explorer-link works. Explorer page: preset-straitofmalacca fly-to works, explorer-collection-select/start-input/end-input fields work, btn-search-scenes returned 30 scenes in ~25s ('30 scenes · Microsoft Planetary Computer STAC (open, no key)'), 30 scene-result-<id> cards rendered, 6 scene-preview-<id> thumbnails resolved within 6 s window (rest were still loading; some previews returned 502 from PC rendered_preview and gracefully fell back to 'no preview' label — no client crash). gibs-layer-select toggled a GIBS basemap without console errors. Ingestion page as analyst: live-ais-panel visible with live-ais-badge='not configured' and live-ais-stats rendered; live-ais-key-input NOT rendered (correct). Ingestion page as admin: live-ais-key-input, live-ais-region-select, btn-save-live-ais, btn-toggle-live-ais all present; btn-toggle-live-ais disabled when not configured (correct). Case detail (SPL-20260610-001, id resolved via dashboard link): case-detail loads, map-toggle-satellite-layer button present, toggles GIBS layer on/off without page errors, case-number still SPL-20260610-001 after toggle. tab-candidates/tab-timeline/tab-files all clickable. Compare and Zones pages navigate without errors. All 3 role logins working (admin/supervisor/analyst).

integration_issues.issue: Some /api/satellite/preview requests return 502 (backend proxying to Planetary Computer 'rendered_preview' asset which is intermittently unavailable). UI falls back gracefully to 'no preview' text — no crash — but 20+ 502s appear in the browser console for a 30-result search. Consider caching successful previews and/or a short retry with backoff before failing.

action_items: (Optional) Add short retry/backoff or caching to /api/satellite/preview so intermittent 502s from Planetary Computer don't flood the browser console during a 30-scene explorer search. Current UX (per-card 'no preview' fallback) already avoids user-visible crashes.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/satellite.py: solid validation — bbox order & range, area cap 3600 deg², collection whitelist, 502 wrapper on external STAC failures. register endpoint is idempotent via provider_scene_id lookup and returns _id-clean payload. Good use of require_role('analyst') for register vs get_current_user for read.
satellite.py _normalize: covers both S1 (sar:*) and S2 (eo:cloud_cover, s2:product_type) property namespaces. httpx timeouts appropriate (60s search/item, 120s preview). No _id leakage.

routers/ais_live.py: admin-gated PUT, api_key masked in status, empty string clears key, bbox shape [[lat,lon],[lat,lon]] validated per-corner in range. Audit event redacts api_key. start() re-invoked on settings change — good.

ais_live._run: correct guard for enabled+api_key, sleeps 5s when unconfigured (so status.running stays true without hammering), catches all exceptions with 10s backoff, buffered flush every 8s or 500 msgs. state.error surfaces up to 300 chars.

SceneExplorer.jsx: Preview component correctly cleans up blob URLs on unmount, wraps blob fetch in try/catch (falls back to 'no preview'). GibsLayer toggle honors the acquisition-date-aware WMTS template. Bounding-box tracked via useMapEvents moveend and passed to search. All key elements have data-testid.

LiveAis.jsx: 8s polling of /ais/live/status is reasonable. Admin-only inputs correctly gated via hasRole(user,'admin'). btn-toggle-live-ais disabled when not configured — clear affordance. Boxes JSON.stringify in status line is developer-facing but fine for this ops panel.
CaseMap.jsx: gibs prop only renders GibsLayer when acquisitionTime is present — good defensive check. Layer transparency and z-index appropriate.
